environment.description: EKS 1.28 pod running on Amazon Linux 2 worker node (ami-0abcdef1234567890). Pod runs as privileged container with SYS_PTRACE capability. Container image built with gcc 11.3 default flags (-O2, no sanitizers). Pod security context: privileged=true, allowPrivilegeEscalation=true. No seccomp profile applied. gRPC server exposed via NodePort 30443. Kubernetes service account has cluster-admin ClusterRoleBinding. No network policies applied to namespace.
